title: DASH - Request to partially turn off the pod expiration reminder
symptom: In AndroidAPS 3.0-rc1, the Dash settings only allow completely turning off the pod expiration reminder, but users want to disable the 72-hour alarm separately while keeping the 80-hour (or 79-hour) alarm.
cause: The Dash pod has an additional built-in safety alarm at exactly 72 hours that cannot be turned off, and the adjustable expiration alarm is referenced to 72 hours instead of 80 hours as in Eros.
fix: The issue was fixed in commit d6e6a986427c8ff9db464e0dee92639fc526e94e, referenced in issue #2691.
evidence_quote: This issue can be closed, as it has been fixed in: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/2691
